import itertools
# universe of region types by membership (t,d,e,b); enumerate subsets of region types that are nonempty
regs=[r for r in itertools.product([0,1],repeat=4) if (not r[0] or r[1]) and (not r[1] or r[2])]
c1_always=True; c2_always=True; found=False
for mask in range(1,1<<len(regs)):
    S=[regs[i] for i in range(len(regs)) if mask>>i&1]
    if not any(r[0] for r in S) or not any(r[1] for r in S): continue
    if not any(r[2] and r[3] for r in S): continue
    found=True
    c1=all(r[3] for r in S if r[0]); c2=any(r[1] and r[3] for r in S)
    c1_always&=c1; c2_always&=c2
assert found
ans={(False,False):'A',(False,True):'B',(True,True):'C',(True,False):'D'}[(c1_always,c2_always)]
assert ans=='A'
assert all(ans!=o for o in 'BCD')

from itertools import product
# elements as (T,D,E,B) memberships; enumerate models with a few individuals
import itertools
types=[t for t in product([0,1],repeat=4) if (not t[0] or t[1]) and (not t[1] or t[2])]
def concl(m):
    I=all(x[3] for x in m if x[0])
    II=any(x[1] and x[3] for x in m)
    return I,II
always=[True,True]; ever=[False,False]
for n in range(1,4):
    for m in itertools.product(types,repeat=n):
        if not any(x[2] and x[3] for x in m): continue
        r=concl(m)
        for i in range(2):
            always[i]&=r[i]; ever[i]|=r[i]
assert always==[False,False]
follows=tuple(always)
vals={'A':(False,False),'B':(False,True),'C':(True,True),'D':(True,False)}
assert follows==vals['A']
for k in 'BCD': assert follows!=vals[k]

# place Net as front (0,0,1); moving down column rotates about x-axis
faces={}
seq=['Bat','Net','Stick','Goal']
normals=[(0,1,0),(0,0,1),(0,-1,0),(0,0,-1)]
for f,n in zip(seq,normals): faces[f]=n

verifications.check_code:
def rel(expr):
    t=expr.split(); ppl=t[0::2]; ops=t[1::2]
    male=set(); female=set(); father={}; spouse={}; bro={}; parent={}
    for a,o,b in zip(ppl,ops,ppl[1:]):
        if o=='!': male.add(a); parent.setdefault(b,set()).add(a)
        if o=='&': male.add(a); bro[a]=b
        if o=='*': female.add(a); male.add(b); spouse[a]=b; spouse[b]=a
        if o=='#': female.add(a); parent.setdefault(a,set()).add(b)
    if male & female: return False
    # need: S wife of X, X brother of H, H husband of M
    S='S'; M='M'
    if S not in female or S not in spouse: return False
    X=spouse[S]
    if X not in bro: return False
    H=bro[X]
    if spouse.get(H)==M: return True
    # H and M co-parents of a child, H male -> H husband of M
    kids=[c for c,ps in parent.items() if H in ps and M in ps]
    return bool(kids) and H in male and M not in male
opts={'A':'S & F * J ! I # M','B':'S & F ! J * I # M','C':'S * F & J ! I # M','D':'S & F # J ! I * M'}
good=[k for k,v in opts.items() if rel(v)]
assert good==['C']
steps: S * F: S is wife of F; F & J: F is brother of J
J ! I: J is father of I; I # M: I is daughter of M, so M is I's mother and J's wife
So S is the wife of M's husband's brother
A, B, D start with S & (S is a brother, male), so cannot be a wife
